title: Effective independence of the nine JEPX areas
why: "positive in all nine areas" is the paper's principal robustness currency; interconnection capacity is allocated through the spot auction, so area prices coincide whenever no interface binds and nine areas may not be nine replications

institutional_coupling.reading: the share of slots on which every area clears at one price. High values mean the areas are one market most of the time and the per-area counts are not independent

statistical_coupling.quantity: per-area daily improvement of the headline pre-gate tier over the price-only baseline -- the series the 'nine of nine' counts are made about
statistical_coupling.reading: the effective number of independent improvement series, by the participation ratio of the correlation matrix's eigenvalues. Nine means independent, one means identical
